Message:
I’ve always loved things
that were beautiful.

On that day, when I was a child
captivated by the beauty of
the stars in the night sky,

my dream of becoming
a stargazer led me to come
knocking on a temple’s gates.

It was there that I laid eyes on
something even more beautiful.

Angel lord Samyaza.
The very moment their divine
radiance enchanted me,

I decided to serve them
as their nun.

Then, when Lord Samyaza
chose me to save the world,
I finally felt
acknowledged by them.
I was truly happy.

And...the instant I met
the great Hero who I’d be
accompanying on this journey,
my fate was etched in stone.

His spirit, undefiled
and the purest white,
was more beautiful
than the stars,
and even Lord Samyaza.
Truly a light from
Heaven above.

Just like admirers of stars
decide to become stargazers,
and devotees of angels decide
to become nuns...

I was enchanted by the Hero...
and so I decided to serve him.
